content.subject: C.H. Robinson acquisition – reconciliation impact
content.draft_text:
Hi Bruce,
C.H. Robinson announced the acquisition of DeSpir Logistics. Such M&A expands reconciliation workload across finance teams, adding layers of intercompany matching and manual adjustments.
We embed a ledger‑matching engine that auto‑reconciles intercompany freight invoices, posting adjustments to your ERP ledger.
If you have 15 minutes next week, I can walk through a quick demo of the engine and discuss fit.
